name: History of the Orcish Kingdoms
body:
Author Lubboch the Miserable, orc, LE; Language Orcish.
Alphabet Dwarven; DC 13; Pages 185 Price 1,726 gp; Weight 4.6 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Despite this history’s extremely selective viewpoint, (all orcish defeats are omitted), it still proves a valuable resource. Clearly the most successful orcish attempt at scholastic research, Lubboch breathes more life into the history’s major players than any other orcish chronicler. He even grudgingly praises dwarves and humans, although he still mocks elves at every opportunity. The book’s elf skin cover, however, reinforces Lubboch’s inherent racial prejudice in addition to shocking unsuspecting handlers of the manual. Printed on parchment, approximately twelve copies are currently in circulation.

The character receives a +1 insight bonus to AC and attack rolls against orcs.

MISINTERPRETATION

Misinterpretation The reader receives a -1 insight penalty to AC and attack rolls against orcs.

Gross Misinterpretation The reader receives a -1 insight penalty to AC and attack rolls against orcs.
